text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At last... The day of the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Countless fans swarmed the venue, eager to 
catch a glimpse of Silence Suzuka after 
her breathtaking performances across so 
many races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In stark contrast to the buzzing 
excitement of the spectators, a heavy 
atmosphere hung over the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After confessing her leg pain to Trainer, 
Silence Suzuka pleaded with them to 
believe in her and still send her out onto 
the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about the future, she should have 
scratched from the race... but trusting in 
her, the Trainer sent her out onto the 
track.
